Name: First Year Starter
Author: theimmortalcrab
Description:
This mod is designed only for your first year. NPCs will send you mail with items that will help kickstart your farm. As far as I know, there are no conflicts with other mods. Please let me know if you run into an issue, seeing as this is the first version. I hope you enjoy!

How to Install:
1. Download the First Year Starting Kit file
2. Go to your downloads section in file explorer
3. Unzip the file
4. Place in your Stardew Valley Mods folder




First Spring:
Day 1-Green Bean Starters, Potato Seeds, Kale Seeds
Day 5-Garden Pots, Quality Sprinklers

First Summer:
Day 1-Pepper Seeds, Blueberry Seeds, Tomato Seeds, Corn Seeds, Hops Starters, Radish Seeds, Wheat Seeds

First Fall:
Day 1-Cranberry Seeds, Eggplant Seeds, Amaranth Seeds, Bok Choy Seeds, Yam Seeds, Grape Starters

First Winter:
Fall 21: Hay
